lines.text: When David was old, he installed his son Absalom as king over Israel and gathered the leaders, priests and Levites.
Of the 38,000 counted Levites, 24,000 were to oversee the work of the house of the LORD.
David divided the Levites by the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
David said the LORD had come to dwell in Jerusalem, so the Levites no longer needed to carry the tabernacle.
The Levites were to assist the descendants of Moses and stand every morning and evening to give thanks.
